surfaces.name: qwen-image-edit

parameters.name: images
parameters.summary: Conditioning input image(s), in prompt order.

surfaces.summary: Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 instruction editing (20B zero_cond_t DiT + Qwen2.5-VL conditioning): multi-image fusion, identity-preserving edits, 1024²-area output, 20-step true CFG. Opt-in step-residual cache via metaData stepCacheMode (conservative|aggressive).

surfaces.name: qwen-image-flash

parameters.name: adapters
parameters.summary: Adapters (LoRA) by catalog id, each {id, strength?, conditioning?}; up to 4, strength 0.0…2.0.

surfaces.summary: Qwen-Image-Flash text-to-image (NVIDIA DMD2 4-step distill of Qwen-Image, 20B MMDiT + Qwen2.5-VL conditioning): four deterministic steps on a static shift-3 FlowMatch Euler schedule with guidance internalized (true CFG 1.0), tested at 1024²; any size divisible by 16. Up to 4 adapters per request (`adapters`, by catalog id), rank-stacked on the resident DiT.

model.notes: Instruction editing with up to 3 references, named "Picture 1", "Picture 2"… in the instruction. Draws about 1024² at the first image's aspect; 20 steps of true CFG. Needs about 63 GB.
model.title: Qwen-Image-Edit 2511

x-qwen.guidance.description: True classifier-free guidance: how strongly the instruction steers. 1 turns CFG off.

x-qwen.steps.description: Denoising steps; fewer is faster and coarser.
